text: AI is changing how we create art, music, and writing. Today, computers can generate paintings, compose songs, and even write stories. Some people are amazed by this, while others have doubts. Can a machine truly be creative, or is it just copying patterns from human work? Human creativity comes from emotions, experiences, and imagination. AI, on the other hand, learns from large amounts of data. It can produce surprising results, but it does not understand what it makes. Perhaps the best future is when humans and AI work together, using technology as a tool to support our own ideas.
